decisions.reason: Specifying Danish placeholder text for the date field does not resolve or change the separate default document-language conflict.
The date-field placeholder wording does not change the existing requirements that persistent control labels be unique and not repeat field content.
The source specifies placeholder content but does not change when or how placeholder text must clear upon field activation.
The requested date-field wording does not alter the field implementation architecture or editable-text mechanism.
The date-field placeholder text is unrelated to bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The source changes one user-facing field string and does not change style-catalog coverage or its source style system.
The placeholder wording does not change the independently specified calendar-dropdown date-entry method.
Danish date-field placeholder content does not modify style names, their language, or the NXQ prefix convention.
The date-field text does not alter the supported Word environment or general reliability constraints.
The source has no effect on numbered-list alignment at multi-digit values.
The date-field placeholder wording does not change the required theme-color palette.
The source specifies localized text for a date field and does not affect legacy-content paste behavior or its unresolved formatting workflow.
